The Changes pane can wrap long lines with `w`, so a line wider than the pane is no longer cut off at the edge.

- desk-look: `w` (or the `Wrap` button in the tool row) splits each line wider than the pane over the rows below it. The line number shows on the first row only, the colored edge runs the full height, and a line takes at most 10 rows (the last one is cut with `…`, for minified files). Press it again to go back to one row per line. The setting is kept across reloads. Changed-word highlighting is left off on a line that wraps
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-review, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.75.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
